To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the 0,5–0,18 μm HT SOI CMOS devices are stable and reliable in the temperature range to 300 °C.

the 0,18 μm and 0,5 μm SOICMOS IC's with special layout and tungsten metallisation are stable and reliable in the extended temperature (up to 300 °C) range and can be successfully used in high-temperature SOICMOS applications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of SOI MOSFETS with special layouts, tungsten metallization and SPICE modeling for the extended temperature range.

electrical characterization and reliability of 0.5-0.18 µm SOI CMOS transistors and tungsten metallized interconnections for HT SOI CMOS integrated circuits (IC's) in the extended temperature region (to 300°C).

the electrical characterization and reliability of 0.5 μm SOICMOS technology in the temperature range to 300 ° C, which is the first step in the development of high temperature (HT) SOI CMOS integrated circuits (IC's) for aerospace and space applications.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the SOI MOSFETS with tungsten metallisation are suitable to be used in the extended temperature ranges (to 300°C) for the HT CMOS IC design.

the 0,5-μm SOI CMOS devices with tungsten metallisation have stable electrical characteristics in the range 25-300 °C and the 0,18-μm SOICMOS devices with tungstent metallization can be used for implementation of high-temperature IC's in the range 150-300 °C.

SOI MOSFETS and tungsten metallizations are reliable enough for implementation of HT CMOST IC's (to 300 °C) and the BSIMSOI model is reliable for CMOS IC simulations in the extended temperature interval (to 300°C).
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 0,5-0,18 μm HT SOI CMOS is suitable for implementation of high-temperature SOIC IC's (to +300 °C) for space and automotive applications.
the SOI MOSFETS and tungsten metallized IC's are stable in the extended temperature region (to 300°C) and can be used to design and fabricate HT SOI CMOS devices.
the 0–300 °C SOI MOSFETS and tungsten metallized ICs can be used to develop HT CMOS ICs for high temperature applications.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the HT SOI MOSFETS with tungsten metallizations can be used for the implementation of HT CMO IC's (to about 300 °C) without any additional modifications.
the 300 °C SOI CMOS devices are reliable enough to be used in the extended temperature applications.
the 0–300 °C temperature range is the most important one for SOI MOSFETS and tungsten metallizations.
